tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background in both apps — the 'game-day program stock' paper tone. Ink-80 body text reads 8.15:1 on light paper; white ink-80 reads 12.09:1 on dark paper.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Secondary surface — subtle section fill one step off paper.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Web-only tertiary surface (apps/web/app/globals.css). No dark-mode value is defined in source yet — shown unchanged in dark until the team specs one.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Input and card fill, sits one step above paper. Ink reads 16.95:1 on light chalk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the 'brutalist' fill for primary buttons/badges (bg-ink). Constant across both themes in source — components such as Button and Badge hard-code this value rather than branching on theme; see the README's alignment notes.

tokens.name: ink-80
tokens.usage: Default body copy on paper or chalk (8.15:1 / 16.06:1).

tokens.name: ink-60
tokens.usage: Secondary/muted text and mono field labels on paper or chalk (4.00:1 — passes only at 14px+/bold; keep field-label sizes at 9px+bold, which the source does).

tokens.name: ink-40
tokens.usage: Decorative and disabled marks only — not text. Measures 2.32:1 on chalk, below the 4.5:1 floor, so placeholders moved to ink-60 (2026-10-20, landed 2026-10-21).

tokens.name: ink-20
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and disabled/unselected chip borders. Non-text; no contrast floor applies.

tokens.name: ink-10
tokens.usage: Faint fills and the disabled hard-shadow offset. Non-text.

tokens.name: ink-inv
tokens.usage: Web-only inverse ink (apps/web/tailwind.config.ts) for text on dark surfaces such as the auth split's ink aside panel. Defined but not yet consumed by any shared component read in this sync.

tokens.name: ink-inv-80
tokens.usage: Inverse body text at 80% — paired with ink-inv, same caveat.

tokens.name: ink-inv-60
tokens.usage: Inverse muted text — paired with ink-inv, same caveat.

tokens.name: ink-inv-40
tokens.usage: Inverse placeholder text — paired with ink-inv, same caveat.

tokens.name: ink-inv-20
tokens.usage: Inverse hairline borders. Non-text.

tokens.name: ink-inv-10
tokens.usage: Inverse faint fills. Non-text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Web-only default hairline divider. No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Web-only medium hairline divider. No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: Web-only strong hairline divider. No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue — links, focus rings, selected-state text/border (5.27:1 on light paper, 6.23:1 on dark paper).

tokens.name: signal-deep
tokens.usage: Web-only deep signal variant, source unspecified use. No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-state background wash behind signal borders (OptionRow, Chip, BigChoice). No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: hi-vis
tokens.usage: High-visibility accent — live badges, hi-vis button fill, selection glow, text selection background. Ink reads 14.44:1 against it on light hi-vis.

tokens.name: court
tokens.usage: Success/confirmed state as a FILL, dot or icon — e.g. the Done button (court fill, ink label, 6.0:1). Never small text on paper (2.38:1); use court-ink for green text. Court-dark on dark paper passes at 10.74:1.

tokens.name: whistle
tokens.usage: Warning accent — used as a FILL (badge-live-adjacent flashes, block colour), never as small text: whistle-as-text on paper measures 1.36:1.

tokens.name: whistle-ink
tokens.usage: Yellow/warning TEXT: 5.04:1 on paper, 5.88:1 on chalk — the warn badge label and warning copy. In both Tailwind configs (whistle.ink) and mobile theme.ts. No dark-mode value documented yet.

tokens.name: foul
tokens.usage: Error/destructive state as a FILL, dot, icon or border. Not for small text on paper (3.19:1) or white labels on a red fill (4.17:1) — use foul-ink for both. Foul-dark on dark paper passes at 6.01:1.

tokens.name: court-ink
tokens.usage: Green TEXT that must read — the badge-confirmed label and success copy: 4.57:1 on paper, 5.97:1 under white. The court counterpart of whistle-ink. Dark value reuses court-dark (10.74:1 on dark paper).

tokens.name: foul-ink
tokens.usage: Red TEXT and destructive fills with white labels — error hints, badge-foul, the danger button: 5.09:1 on paper, 6.6:1 under white. Reserve for errors and hard-to-undo actions (cancel a game, remove a ref); declining a game is NOT danger. Dark value reuses foul-dark (6.01:1).

tokens.name: ink-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for ink (primary) buttons — a lightened ink so the press is visible on the darkest fill. Paper label reads 9.6:1.

tokens.name: hi-vis-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for the hi-vis button. Ink label reads 11.3:1.

tokens.name: foul-ink-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for the danger-fill button (foul-ink darkened). White label reads 8.9:1.

tokens.name: chalk-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for chalk surfaces — option rows, big choice tiles, tappable cards.

tokens.name: signal-tint-press
tokens.usage: Pressed wash for an already-selected choice — a deeper signal-tint so changing a selection still feels like a press.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Headlines and the REF<EE> wordmark — InterTight_900Black at tight tracking (the 'tightest' scale step).

styles.name: scoreboard-numeral
styles.usage: Big numeral readouts — BigChoice's quarter/half/crew-size picker figures.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and UI copy — InterTight_500Medium.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Telemetry eyebrow label above a section (the '.kicker' class) — JetBrainsMono_700Bold, uppercase.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Button and CTA text — uppercase mono bold.

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: Badge and status-pill text — uppercase mono bold.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a form field.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into fields — JetBrainsMono_500Medium, on chalk fill.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Stripes and rules only — ZebraRule and full-bleed dividers. No longer used on surfaces (the system moved to the Rounded scale on 2026-10-20).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, textareas, selects, affix fields, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, option rows, big choice tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets — game cards, form shells, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, toggles and toggle thumbs, status dots.

tokens.name: hard
tokens.usage: The brutalist hover-offset shadow on primary/secondary buttons and a focused form-shell card — no blur, hard-edged.

tokens.name: hard-signal
tokens.usage: Hover-offset shadow variant in signal blue (web tailwind.config.ts).

tokens.name: hard-hivis
tokens.usage: Hover-offset shadow variant in hi-vis — the .btn-hi hover state.

tokens.name: ring-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for choices ('ring to choose') — chips, option rows, big choice, toggles, tappable cards. Pointer devices only.

tokens.name: ring-hover-selected
tokens.usage: Hover ring on a choice that is already selected.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / Switch Control focus on every interactive control (:focus-visible). Never shown on tap.

tokens.name: glow-field-focus
tokens.usage: Text-field focus glow, paired with a signal border. Fields have no hover state.

components.TextField kit: apps/web/components/ui/Field.tsx (Label, TextField, TextArea, AffixField, SelectField, DateField); apps/mobile/components/ui/DropdownSelect.tsx (select)
components.IconSet: apps/web/components/ui/Icon.tsx (34 Feather glyphs, MIT, inlined for parity with @expo/vector-icons)
